online_protocol.evaluation_frames: 128 evenly spaced unique common GT RGB indices shared by all four models in a scene; fixed before quality; all associated poses used for ATE
online_protocol.train_config: current local project fast.yaml, only fixed mapping budget + GI mode + symmetric diagnostic logging overrides; same original Selector/TF/Protection/Maturity/CD
online_protocol.shadow: complete fr1_room seed2026 Raw teacher, exact reference comparison every existing full refresh; require early/middle/late before AB
online_protocol.h: first existing full refresh with >=8 valid observed candidates; h=16*median(cbrt(sx*sy*sz)); fixed per map until reset
online_protocol.teacher: same percentile/maturity builder; complete marginal sequence encoded as unique FP32 order scores, all candidates, no approximate tail
online_protocol.refresh: existing full SGI refresh only, publication remapped on exact topology callbacks; warmup explicitly Raw until first publication
online_protocol.primary: production cached-u selected rendering at1/5%; Full quality and SE3 ATE
online_protocol.secondary: same absoluteK of production probability using minimum final N across four scene models; diagnostic only
online_protocol.quality_gate: No stable 1/5% regression on fr1_room; no systematic Full/ATE degradation; mechanistic redundancy/coverage evidence; classify >10% mapping overhead or visible refresh stall as performance problem, independent of algorithm quality. n=2 no significance claim.
online_protocol.seed_scope: Mapper std/torch RNG and OpenCV RNG use same paired seed; async ORB/SLAM is not bitwise deterministic

analysis_preregistration.primary: fr1_room production cached-uniform selection at1/5%; paired seeds2026/2027, report each ratio and seed
analysis_preregistration.stable_quality_regression: both seeds have negative PSNR delta and mean delta<-0.10dB at either primary ratio
analysis_preregistration.visible_positive_benefit: mean primary four paired PSNR deltas>0.05dB and at least3/4 deltas>=0; SSIM/LPIPS tradeoffs reported separately
analysis_preregistration.full_map_regression: both primary-scene seeds negative Full PSNR and mean delta<-0.20dB
analysis_preregistration.systematic_ATE_regression: both primary-scene paired SE3 ATE changes exceed max(0.005m,0.10*RawATE)
analysis_preregistration.performance_problem: scene mean Mapping wall overhead>10%, or consistent tracking-tail latency degradation; report all refresh p95/max and standalone marginal amortized cost
analysis_preregistration.online_GO: exact offline+shadow gates, no stable selected/Full/ATE regression, positive benefit, reduced same-K snapshot redundancy, and no performance problem
analysis_preregistration.weak_or_NO_GO: if quality merely similar without clear benefit, classify online benefit weak/NO-GO; never reinterpret offline redundancy GO as online GO
analysis_preregistration.second_scene: fr1_desk is zero-tuning directional check, report independently; no checkpoint or seed selection
analysis_preregistration.tracking_limit: tracking per-frame distribution and GI association wait counters measured; no per-refresh causal attribution from separate logs
analysis_preregistration.no_auto_remedy: no sparse approximate path, architecture changes, threshold/LR tuning or altered refresh cadence to rescue results

source_sync.policy: local project code/config authoritative; datasets/results/models/dependencies/build caches preserved

script_hash_note: executed_scripts is the reporting-time snapshot; delivered_script_hashes records final delivered helpers, including later packaging-only revisions
